exercises.name: Walking knee hugs
exercises.cue: Pull knee to chest, balance on standing leg for 1 second.

exercises.name: Walking quad pulls
exercises.cue: Tall posture, knee points down.

exercises.name: Leg swings — front/back
exercises.cue: Hold something for balance; relaxed, full range.

exercises.name: Leg swings — side/side
exercises.cue: Open the hip, don't twist the spine.

exercises.name: Walking lunges
exercises.cue: Front knee tracks over second toe; keep torso tall.

exercises.name: Glute bridges
exercises.cue: Squeeze glutes at the top; ribs down.

exercises.name: High knees
exercises.cue: Quick turnover; emphasize lift, not speed.

exercises.name: Pick-ups (only where the session card calls for them)
exercises.cue: UA format: 8-10 s early in the season, up to 15 s later; fun, fast, relaxed - never a sprint; at least 2 min easy jog between. The card sets the count.

pre_run.notes: Do this BEFORE every run. Pick-ups, fast downhill pick-ups and hill sprints live on the Friday fast-feet card (rev 2.3) - not in the warm-up of other runs; skip them on recovery days, long runs and the AeT test. Recovery weeks 1-2: mobility items only, gently. HEEL: keep ankle mobility pain-free; no end-range dorsiflexion loading while the posterior heel is reactive.

exercises.name: Walking cooldown
exercises.cue: Walk until HR is below 110 bpm before stretching.

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.cue: Tuck pelvis under to feel the stretch in the front of the hip too.

exercises.name: Standing calf stretch (bent + straight knee)
exercises.cue: Two angles per side, knee straight (gastroc) and bent (soleus). Stretch on FLAT ground - do not hang the heel off a step while the posterior heel is reactive (compression at the attachment).

exercises.name: Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch
exercises.cue: Squeeze the back glute first, THEN lean forward.

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.cue: Square hips. If knee complains, lie back instead (figure-4 supine).

exercises.name: Foam roll quads, IT band, calves (optional)
exercises.cue: 60 seconds per area; pause and breathe on tender spots.

post_run.notes: Within 15 min of finishing. Especially after long runs, B2B days and descent sessions. Walking cooldown to HR < 110 first.

exercises.name: Foot tripod + short-foot set
exercises.cue: Barefoot or socks. Set the arch before loading it.

exercises.name: Ankle dorsiflexion rocks
exercises.cue: Half-kneel, knee over toes, heel down - pain-free range only; stop short of any posterior-heel pinch.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.cue: 2 s squeeze at top.

exercises.name: Bodyweight squat
exercises.cue: Slow and full range; the knee-gate warmup — no loaded knee work until these feel silent.

exercises.name: Bodyweight step-down (low box)
exercises.cue: Final knee check before any loaded step work.

pre_lower.notes: KNEE GATE lives here: loaded step-downs/step-ups only after the bodyweight versions are pain-free and the knee is warm.

exercises.name: Standing calf stretch (straight + bent knee)
exercises.cue: Both angles (gastroc and soleus) on FLAT ground - no heel hanging off a step while the heel is reactive.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch
exercises.cue: Back glute on first, then lean.

exercises.name: Ankle dorsiflexion mobilization (wall)
exercises.cue: Knee to wall, heel down, pain-free range only.

post_lower.notes: NEW post-lower split (replaces the old single post_strength). Lower-body specific: calves/ankle/hip get the cooldown minutes.

exercises.name: Thoracic opener over foam roller
exercises.cue: Gentle extension. Deprioritized vs last cycle (pole-driven need is gone) but kept as a short reset.

daily_routines.title: Foot & Arch Correctives (pronation program)

exercises.name: Short-foot activation
exercises.cue: Barefoot. Lift the arch without curling toes.

exercises.name: Toe yoga
exercises.cue: Big toe down, little toes up; then reverse.

exercises.name: Heel walks
exercises.cue: Toes up, walk on heels across the room.

exercises.name: Big-toe extension mobilization
exercises.cue: Kneel, toes tucked, gentle sit-back. Big-toe range for push-off.

exercises.name: Calf raise with eversion bias
exercises.cue: Rise with slight outward pressure — anti-pronation pattern.

daily_routines.notes: NON-NEGOTIABLE, every day of the cycle (right-foot pronation program). Pair with the daily collagen + vitamin C dose on non-lifting days.

daily_routines.title: Hip & Lateral-Chain Activation

exercises.name: Clamshells (band)
exercises.cue: Pelvis still; open from the hip.

exercises.name: Side-lying hip abduction
exercises.cue: Heel leads, toe slightly down — glute med, not TFL.

exercises.name: Banded lateral walk
exercises.cue: Athletic stance, steps controlled both directions.

exercises.name: Single-leg balance reach
exercises.cue: Stand on one leg, reach the free foot to 3 points of a clock.

daily_routines.notes: P1 component (d) daily floor: the lateral-stability chain (pronating right foot -> lateral ankle -> lateral knee) gets touched every morning; the loaded version lives in Lower B.

daily_routines.title: Shoulder & Scapular Maintenance

exercises.name: Band pull-aparts
exercises.cue: Squeeze shoulder blades; no shrug.

exercises.name: Band external rotation
exercises.cue: Elbow pinned to ribs. Left shoulder priority.

exercises.name: Scapular wall slides
exercises.cue: Forearms on wall, slide up without ribs flaring.

daily_routines.notes: Left-shoulder maintenance; matters more from January with ~37 mi of race poling ahead.

daily_routines.title: Evening Heel & Tendon Isometrics (FR-x)

exercises.name: Bent-knee soleus isometric (wall lean or loaded seated)
exercises.cue: ~70% effort, heel on the floor. The posterior-heel dose: frequency beats volume.

exercises.name: Resisted eversion isometric (band)
exercises.cue: Both sides; right +1 set.

phase_overrides.modification: Holds 30-45 s at moderate effort; mild heel discomfort (<= 2/10) that eases during the hold is fine - isometrics are analgesic.
Monday-Wednesday only (Thursday's isometric session covers Thursday); none Friday-Sunday.

daily_routines.notes: REPLACES tendon_isometrics_evening (Vermont cycle) with the posterior heel as the priority site. Skip on Lower A/B days (the session covers it). Run coach's read on the heel: steep-ascent load -> more calf isometrics + graded practice at those grades. Not a diagnosis: a clinician look if it persists > 2 weeks or returns in training.

supplements.name: Vitamin D3
supplements.notes: Autumn blood work suggested (25-OH vitamin D, ferritin, CBC) before the winter volume block - dose by result. Do not supplement iron without a low ferritin result.

supplements.name: Omega-3 fish oil (EPA/DHA)
supplements.rationale: Anti-inflammatory support without blunting adaptation (unlike NSAIDs, which stay OFF around loading).

supplements.name: Collagen peptides + Vitamin C
supplements.timing: 30-60 min BEFORE lower/tendon strength sessions; on non-lifting days, with the morning foot-corrective block
supplements.rationale: Peri-loading collagen availability for tendon remodeling — the P1 nutritional lever. Daily low-dose beats one big weekly dose because collagen synthesis has a refractory window.
supplements.notes: THE priority supplement this block. Never skipped on Lower A / Lower B days.

supplements.name: Creatine monohydrate
supplements.timing: post-run or post-strength, any consistent daily slot
supplements.rationale: Strength/power support during the HSR block; consistency matters more than timing.

supplements.name: Whey protein isolate
supplements.timing: post-session windows and to top up daily protein
supplements.rationale: Hits the 1.7-1.9 g/kg/day protein target that tissue remodeling at 50 demands.

supplements.name: Magnesium glycinate
supplements.rationale: Sleep quality — recovery is the P1 multiplier.

supplements.name: Electrolytes (SaltStick)
supplements.dose: Temperature-tiered: < 12 C none scheduled (gel + mix cover it); 12-22 C 1 capsule/60 min; > 22 C 1 capsule/40-45 min
supplements.rationale: Vermont sodium (515-675 mg/hr) was deliberately low for 56 F and caused no cramping; Tuscany's 0-30 C swing needs a tiered rate, not a flat one.

supplements.name: Caffeine (GU Roctane caffeine gels)
supplements.dose: 35 mg per caffeinated gel. Training runs > 3 h: 1-3 in the final third. Evening/dark sessions: one at dusk (test). Race: see the 4/17 override (<= ~400 mg total).
supplements.timing: Final third of long efforts; dusk on headlamp runs
supplements.rationale: Vermont: 3 caffeinated gels in the last 2.5 h, clean. Tuscany adds a 15-17 h day and a dark finish - timing is tested at dusk on 1/10, late in the day on the 2/21 long effort, and in the late hours of the 3/7 and 3/21 rehearsals (late-hours tests, not dark finishes - the 3/21 headlamp finish was dropped in run plan rev 2.4).

daily_targets.general_guidance: Highest regular carb day. Breakfast = race-morning rehearsal. During-run fueling follows the phase ladder below. Post-run recovery is the priority meal of the week.
daily_targets.notes: FUELING LADDER (FR-w: the problem is calorie MIX, not volume). BASE W3-13: proven gels every 25-30 min + water, 200-250 cal/hr; from W7 add ONE real-food item at ~hour 2 on runs >= 2.5 h, rotating (salted boiled potato, rice ball, 1/4 PB&J, banana, bread + cheese). BUILD W14-22: 250-280 cal/hr as a MIX - gels ~50%, half-strength GU Roctane Energy Drink Mix ~25%, real food ~25% every 45-60 min - so no single source runs over ~150 cal/hr (Vermont's fullness came at ~365 cal/hr, mostly gel + drink). The 2/21 long effort (override) is the J-2 rehearsal of this mix past hour 7. G1 shoe gate 1/31 and the 2/7 long run use this day type - no new fuel variable on a footing test. PEAK W23-26: race protocol v1 (overrides 3/7, 3/21). One new variable per run; hour 1 always on the proven baseline.

sessions.title: AeT HEART-RATE DRIFT TEST #1 (treadmill, 3%)
sessions.key_cue: Uphill Athlete protocol. SETUP: treadmill at 3% (same machine and grade every test), CHEST STRAP (wet the contacts), fan on, cool room, same time of day and same pre-test meal as test #1, no caffeine in the 3 h before, after a rest day. WARM-UP 15 min: walk, then build speed until HR sits stable for 2-3 min at the STARTING HR. STARTING HR: test #1 = 145 bpm (between your race-validated ~136-150 band and the 149 working cap). Retests start at the last measured AeT. LAP. TEST 60 min at ONE locked speed and grade - do not touch the controls. LAP at 30:00 and at 60:00. COOL-DOWN 10 min easy. RESULT = avg HR 2nd half / avg HR 1st half - 1. <3.5% = your AeT is higher: retest +5 bpm. 3.5-5.0% = AeT = your starting HR. >5% = started above AeT: retest -5 bpm. GATE: AeT >= 152 (within 10% of LTHR 168) -> no aerobic deficiency; Z3 sessions switch on. Below 152 -> Z1-2 only, retest in 4-6 weeks. FIT to the Drive inbox the same day.
sessions.notes: Intensity: Test. The hr_cap_bpm here is only the provisional alert; the starting HR in the cue governs. Treadmill incline is NOT counted in elevation_gain_ft (no matching descent, no eccentric load). The result re-anchors EVERY AeT-referenced cap in this plan by patch revision (hr_anchor field). THE GATE for the whole cycle: it decides whether and when Z3 enters the plan, and it resets every easy-day ceiling. If the result is inconclusive (<3.5% or >5%), the retest takes Tuesday 10/20's slot.

sessions.title: Easy TI swim
sessions.key_cue: TI FOUNDATION DRILLS: balance/superman glide, skate position, then zipper and switch drills in 25 m repeats with full rest. Stop each drill before form breaks. EFFORT 3-4/10 throughout; if breathing gets ragged, go back to drills. HR is NOT capped: swim HR runs well below running HR at the same effort, so the running AeT cap does not apply - go by feel. SHOULDER RULE: stop at the first pinch at the front or top of the shoulder (left is the priority side); no paddles; hands enter wide ('railroad tracks'), never crossing the midline. KICK: relaxed 2-beat; ease it off if the calf or posterior heel tightens; no breaststroke kick (knees). Gentle wall push-offs.
sessions.notes: Cross-training (athlete, rev 2.2): general aerobic + upper-body work, light on the legs. NOT counted in run mileage, vertical or the ramp guard; counted in weekly hours. If the left shoulder reacts, swimming is dropped BEFORE Upper A (Upper A's cuff work is the protective part). Swim first, Upper B later (Upper B is push, so it complements the swim's pull).

sessions.title: Aerobic climbing - run the climbs at or below AeT
sessions.key_cue: After a 15-min Z1-2 warm-up: 3 x 8 min of continuous climbing at +3..+7%, jog/walk down between. Remainder of the run Z1-2 on rolling terrain. RULE: HR at the alert (AeT) -> hike immediately until AeT-5, then run again. Hiking to stay aerobic is the session working, not failing. READ-OUT (FR tracking ask #4): lap-press every climb block; RS reports run_pct and mean HR on +5..+10% versus the Vermont baseline (debrief s3: ~60% run share on +5..+10% late). Target over the cycle: crossover up from ~7-8% at unchanged HR. WATCH ALERT: set a high-HR alert at the hr_cap_bpm value (FR-y) - it is a number the watch enforces, not one you remember.
sessions.fueling_notes: 1 gel at 45 min if over 75 min.
sessions.notes: VENUE (rev 2.4): Alpine loop COUNTERCLOCKWISE - its 1.12-mi +6.2% climb holds the blocks; the way back is mostly gentle (-4.6% average) but ends with 0.5 mi at ~-8.6% (0.25 mi at ~-11%) - run it relaxed, short strides; it is inside the card's descent. Boat Basin (1.5 mi at +6.0%) if the Alpine woods are icy. Intensity: Aerobic quality (priority 1 - uphill running at low HR). SURFACE: gravel/dirt road or smooth trail at the named grade (terrain_intent grade; Terrain_Substitution_Rules_v1); a treadmill is allowed - log it, the descent field drops to the warm-up's.

aet_gate.default_rationale: Aerobic-deficiency path (or untested): Z1-2 only. Strict gate (athlete decision 10/22): no work above AeT until a valid drift test gives AeT within 10% of LTHR.
aet_gate.pass_rule: Swap in if_pass once the latest valid drift test gives AeT >= 152 bpm (within 10% of LTHR 168). UA DOSE RULES (rev 2.3): Z3 starts at <= 5% of the week's run time (Cat 1 entry dose 20-30 min); the FIRST promoted week holds miles and vertical at the reference week (never raise distance, vertical and intensity together); no Z4 until Z3 has run at ~10% of weekly time, then 30/30s first. Promotion applies to Base/Build loading weeks only - Specificity (B2B peak) weeks, taper and race weeks carry no Z3 (UA: ultra S weeks cut Z3). Load fields are identical in both versions, so weekly sums do not change.

sessions.title: Descent skill session (run the downs)
sessions.key_cue: DESCENT INTRO: 2 x 0.75 mi sustained at -5..-8%. Controlled-relaxed. Stop at 2 even if they feel easy - first eccentric dose of the cycle. Climb back up by easy run or hike - the ascent is transport. Median RUNNING cadence 175+ on every rep; lap-press each rep. HR on descents is audited, not governed. WATCH ALERT: set a high-HR alert at the hr_cap_bpm value (FR-y) - it is a number the watch enforces, not one you remember.
sessions.notes: Intensity: Aerobic + eccentric dose (priority 2 / J-4). SURFACE: Boat Basin road (-6.1%, most stable grade in the archive; 1.5 mi continuous, so no rep is longer than 1.5 mi) or a graded fire road; non-technical always. Perkins Memorial Drive is not used (rev 2.4: winter closure, crowding). WINTER PARKING AT THE TOP (RS check 10/22): warm up on the flat at the top, run the first descent as rep 1, end the session at the top - rep count and descent miles unchanged. 24-H SYMPTOM READ (heel, lateral ankle, knees) gates next week's progression. READ-OUT: running-only cadence and step length, first rep vs last rep at matched grade (C-5 basis). WINTER: never on ice - move the day, or garage-ramp repeats / treadmill decline as partial credit. VERTICAL FIX (rev 2.3): distance and elevation now count the full descent of every rep (~317 ft per descent-mile at -6%) and the climb back up - earlier cards understated both.

sessions.title: Easy TI swim
sessions.key_cue: TI FOUNDATION DRILLS: balance/superman glide, skate position, then zipper and switch drills in 25 m repeats with full rest. Stop each drill before form breaks. EFFORT 3-4/10 throughout; if breathing gets ragged, go back to drills. HR is NOT capped: swim HR runs well below running HR at the same effort, so the running AeT cap does not apply - go by feel. SHOULDER RULE: stop at the first pinch at the front or top of the shoulder (left is the priority side); no paddles; hands enter wide ('railroad tracks'), never crossing the midline. KICK: relaxed 2-beat; ease it off if the calf or posterior heel tightens; no breaststroke kick (knees). Gentle wall push-offs.
sessions.notes: Cross-training (athlete, rev 2.2): general aerobic + upper-body work, light on the legs. NOT counted in run mileage, vertical or the ramp guard; counted in weekly hours. If the left shoulder reacts, swimming is dropped BEFORE Upper A (Upper A's cuff work is the protective part). Swim first, Upper B later (Upper B is push, so it complements the swim's pull).

daily_targets.notes: FUELING LADDER (FR-w: the problem is calorie MIX, not volume). BASE W3-13: proven gels every 25-30 min + water, 200-250 cal/hr; from W7 add ONE real-food item at ~hour 2 on runs >= 2.5 h, rotating (salted boiled potato, rice ball, 1/4 PB&J, banana, bread + cheese). BUILD W14-22: 250-280 cal/hr as a MIX - gels ~50%, half-strength GU Roctane Energy Drink Mix ~25%, real food ~25% every 45-60 min - so no single source runs over ~150 cal/hr (Vermont's fullness came at ~365 cal/hr, mostly gel + drink). The 2/21 long effort (override) is the J-2 rehearsal of this mix past hour 7. G1 shoe gate 1/31 and the 2/7 long run use this day type - no new fuel variable on a footing test. PEAK W23-26: race protocol v1 (overrides 3/7, 3/21). One new variable per run; hour 1 always on the proven baseline.

RULE: HR at the alert (AeT) -> hike immediately until AeT-5, then run again. Hiking to stay aerobic is the session working, not failing. HILL SPRINTS x6: 8-10 s uphill at +8..+12% (~85% effort - first sessions deliberately sub-maximal (UA)), full 2-3 min walk-down recovery - never cut the rest short. Progress by adding reps (max +2/week, cap 8), never by lengthening past 10 s; grade stays +8..+12% (posterior heel - deliberate deviation from UA's 30% hills). Alactic - HR is irrelevant, so these are NOT gated by the AeT test (Uphill Athlete permits them in an aerobic-deficiency base). GATED ON: the single-leg hop test (strength plan W6) AND a quiet posterior heel. First thing pulled on any heel, Achilles or forefoot signal. READ-OUT (FR tracking ask #4): lap-press every climb block; RS reports run_pct and mean HR on +5..+10% versus the Vermont baseline (debrief s3: ~60% run share on +5..+10% late). Target over the cycle: crossover up from ~7-8% at unchanged HR. WATCH ALERT: set a high-HR alert at the hr_cap_bpm value (FR-y) - it is a number the watch enforces, not one you remember.

sessions.notes: VENUE (rev 2.4): Alpine loop COUNTERCLOCKWISE - its 1.12-mi +6.2% climb holds the blocks; the way back is mostly gentle (-4.6% average) but ends with 0.5 mi at ~-8.6% (0.25 mi at ~-11%) - run it relaxed, short strides; it is inside the card's descent. Boat Basin (1.5 mi at +6.0%) if the Alpine woods are icy. Intensity: Aerobic quality (priority 1 - uphill running at low HR). SURFACE: gravel/dirt road or smooth trail at the named grade (terrain_intent grade; Terrain_Substitution_Rules_v1); a treadmill is allowed - log it, the descent field drops to the warm-up's. SPRINT HILL (rev 2.4): the athlete's short steep local hills are fine; grade stays +8..+12% (posterior heel).

WINTER PARKING AT THE TOP (RS check 10/22): warm up on the flat at the top, run the first descent as rep 1, end the session at the top - rep count and descent miles unchanged. 24-H SYMPTOM READ (heel, lateral ankle, knees) gates next week's progression. sessions.title: Easy TI swim
sessions.key_cue: DRILLS + SHORT WHOLE STROKE: ~10 min drills, then 25-50 m whole-stroke repeats. Focus: head-spine alignment, patient lead hand, 2-beat kick. Count strokes per length (SPL) and keep it steady. EFFORT 3-4/10 throughout; if breathing gets ragged, go back to drills. HR is NOT capped: swim HR runs well below running HR at the same effort, so the running AeT cap does not apply - go by feel. SHOULDER RULE: stop at the first pinch at the front or top of the shoulder (left is the priority side); no paddles; hands enter wide ('railroad tracks'), never crossing the midline. KICK: relaxed 2-beat; ease it off if the calf or posterior heel tightens; no breaststroke kick (knees). Gentle wall push-offs.
sessions.notes: Cross-training (athlete, rev 2.2): general aerobic + upper-body work, light on the legs. NOT counted in run mileage, vertical or the ramp guard; counted in weekly hours. If the left shoulder reacts, swimming is dropped BEFORE Upper A (Upper A's cuff work is the protective part). Swim first, Upper B later (Upper B is push, so it complements the swim's pull).

sessions.title: Long run - OVERLOOK INTRO (first steep descent of the cycle)
sessions.key_cue: OVERLOOK INTRO (rev 2.4; RS check 10/22) - exposure, not pace. Overlook Mountain, Woodstock NY: gravel-road out-and-back from the trailhead. ORDER: Overlook FIRST, on fresh legs - the 2.2-mi climb at or below AeT (hike to stay under; poles allowed), then the full 2.4-mi descent (~1,370 ft: top 0.75 mi ~-6%, lower 1.65 mi ~-13%, quarter-miles to ~-16%). Controlled-relaxed; POLES on <= -10%; walking the steepest quarters is permitted. Then ~9 mi ESSENTIALLY FLAT (<= ~80 ft total; flat road or rail trail) to the card total. GATED: go only if the 24-h reads after the 10/29 and 11/12 descent sessions were clean and this week's heel/ankle/knee/forefoot morning ratings are <= 2/10. ICE RULE: go/no-go by Fri 11/13 from a road-condition check - any snow or ice on the road above ~2,500 ft = FALLBACK. FALLBACK (rev 2.5): Febapple loop x1 + ~3.5 mi (~13.5 mi / ~1,350 ft). 72-H READ: heel, lateral ankle, knees, forefoot morning ratings on days +1 to +3 - they gate Thu 11/19. FIT to RS (baseline steep-descent sample, pole-on). HR: capped at AeT on climbs (hike to stay under); descents audited. AID ROUTINE: loop past the car/cache and rehearse a fixed <= 2-min stop (bottles, food, out) - no social dwell (ask #7). WATCH ALERT: set a high-HR alert at the hr_cap_bpm value (FR-y) - it is a number the watch enforces, not one you remember.

The 2/21 long effort (override) is the J-2 rehearsal of this mix past hour 7. G1 shoe gate 1/31 and the 2/7 long run use this day type - no new fuel variable on a footing test. sessions.title: AeT HEART-RATE DRIFT TEST #2 (treadmill, 3%)
sessions.key_cue: Uphill Athlete protocol. SETUP: treadmill at 3% (same machine and grade every test), CHEST STRAP (wet the contacts), fan on, COOL room (test #1 was run warm), same time of day and same pre-test meal as test #1, no caffeine in the 3 h before, after a rest day. WARM-UP 15 min: walk, then build speed until HR sits stable for 2-3 min at the STARTING HR. STARTING HR: 147 bpm (rev 2.2 - test #1 on 10/13 settled at 152 and drifted 5.2%, so AeT < 152; 152 - 5 = 147). STABILIZATION RULE: the test starts at the first lap press after HR has held within +/-2 bpm of the starting HR for 3 full minutes; if HR is still rising, drop the belt 0.1-0.2 mph and wait again; if not stable by 15:00, extend the warm-up rather than shorten the test. Retests after this start at the last measured AeT. LAP. TEST 60 min at ONE locked speed and grade - do not touch the controls. LAP at 30:00 and at 60:00. COOL-DOWN 10 min easy. RESULT = avg HR 2nd half / avg HR 1st half - 1. <3.5% = your AeT is higher: retest +5 bpm. 3.5-5.0% = AeT = your starting HR. >5% = started above AeT: retest -5 bpm. GATE: AeT >= 152 (within 10% of LTHR 168) -> no aerobic deficiency; Z3 sessions switch on. Below 152 -> Z1-2 only, retest in 4-6 weeks. FIT to the Drive inbox the same day.
sessions.notes: Intensity: Test. The hr_cap_bpm here is only the provisional alert; the starting HR in the cue governs. The test's 3% incline is NOT counted in elevation_gain_ft (a test, not training load - unlike the treadmill climbing sessions from W18). The result re-anchors EVERY AeT-referenced cap in this plan by patch revision (hr_anchor field). Retest #2, 6 weeks after #1. Test #1 bounded AeT below 152 (no retest on 10/20 - athlete decision 10/13: the gate outcome cannot change in a week). Start at 147. Remaining tests (rev 2.3, strict gate): this one and #3 on 1/19 (recovery week); the 2/16 test is dropped (too late to change anything, and UA has no Z3 in the late B2B weeks). A post-race test sets the next cycle's baseline.

sessions.title: Fast-feet run - pick-ups, downhill pick-ups, sprints
sessions.key_cue: FAST-FEET DAY. 10-15 min easy warm-up, then: HILL SPRINTS x4: 8-10 s uphill at +8..+12% (max effort - recovery-week half dose), full 2-3 min walk-down recovery - never cut the rest short. Progress by adding reps (max +2/week, cap 8), never by lengthening past 10 s; grade stays +8..+12% (posterior heel - deliberate deviation from UA's 30% hills). Alactic - HR is irrelevant, so these are NOT gated by the AeT test (Uphill Athlete permits them in an aerobic-deficiency base). GATED ON: the single-leg hop test (strength plan W6) AND a quiet posterior heel. First thing pulled on any heel, Achilles or forefoot signal. Then 3 x 45 s FAST DOWNHILL PICK-UPS (Uphill Athlete downhill-skill reps): on a SMOOTH -3..-6% road or dirt descent, fast and relaxed - quick feet, cadence 180+, never all-out, never braking; easy jog/walk back up (>= 2 min) between. Pull them on any heel, knee or lateral-ankle signal. Never on ice or wet leaves. Everything else easy, capped at AeT. WATCH ALERT: set a high-HR alert at the hr_cap_bpm value (FR-y) - it is a number the watch enforces, not one you remember.

sessions.title: Easy TI swim
sessions.key_cue: DRILLS + SHORT WHOLE STROKE: ~10 min drills, then 25-50 m whole-stroke repeats. Focus: head-spine alignment, patient lead hand, 2-beat kick. Count strokes per length (SPL) and keep it steady. EFFORT 3-4/10 throughout; if breathing gets ragged, go back to drills. HR is NOT capped: swim HR runs well below running HR at the same effort, so the running AeT cap does not apply - go by feel. SHOULDER RULE: stop at the first pinch at the front or top of the shoulder (left is the priority side); no paddles; hands enter wide ('railroad tracks'), never crossing the midline. KICK: relaxed 2-beat; ease it off if the calf or posterior heel tightens; no breaststroke kick (knees). Gentle wall push-offs.
sessions.notes: Cross-training (athlete, rev 2.2): general aerobic + upper-body work, light on the legs. NOT counted in run mileage, vertical or the ramp guard; counted in weekly hours. sessions.title: Aerobic climbing - run the climbs at or below AeT
sessions.key_cue: After a 15-min Z1-2 warm-up: 2 x 10 min of continuous climbing at +3..+7%, jog/walk down between. Remainder of the run Z1-2 on rolling terrain. RULE: HR at the alert (AeT) -> hike immediately until AeT-5, then run again. Hiking to stay aerobic is the session working, not failing. HILL SPRINTS x6: 8-10 s uphill at +8..+12% (max effort), full 2-3 min walk-down recovery - never cut the rest short. Progress by adding reps (max +2/week, cap 8), never by lengthening past 10 s; grade stays +8..+12% (posterior heel - deliberate deviation from UA's 30% hills). Alactic - HR is irrelevant, so these are NOT gated by the AeT test (Uphill Athlete permits them in an aerobic-deficiency base). GATED ON: the single-leg hop test (strength plan W6) AND a quiet posterior heel. First thing pulled on any heel, Achilles or forefoot signal. READ-OUT (FR tracking ask #4): lap-press every climb block; RS reports run_pct and mean HR on +5..+10% versus the Vermont baseline (debrief s3: ~60% run share on +5..+10% late). Target over the cycle: crossover up from ~7-8% at unchanged HR. WATCH ALERT: set a high-HR alert at the hr_cap_bpm value (FR-y) - it is a number the watch enforces, not one you remember.

sessions.title: GATE D #1 - December qualifying run
sessions.key_cue: GATE D QUALIFYING RUN (criteria agreed August; RS 27 Oct relaxed 'rolling' only - the descent criterion is unchanged): 20-22 mi RUNNABLE, with 3,000+ ft of DESCENT; the downs RUN, not hiked; then a clean 48-hour symptom window. POLE-FREE for comparability (ask #6). ROUTE (rev 2.6, RS ruling 27 Oct): BOAT BASIN x7 round trips (1.53 mi / ~477 ft each way at ~6%), ~21.4 mi / ~3,340 ft of descent - the card carries the route's honest ~3,340 ft (rev 2.7, RS F-1 option a); RS verifies the >= 3,000 ft threshold from the FIT, not the card. Same route, same rep order and same use of the flat section at the bottom between reps on BOTH days (as on 9/14). Park at the top in winter. Every descent RUN; if a rep's descent is hiked for any reason other than a short ice patch, record it in the body report - RS decides whether the day counts. Read against the 9/14 Peregrine baseline on the same road. This is a tissue-tolerance test, NOT a race simulation: do not inflate it (cover note). HR capped at AeT on climbs; descents audited. SHOES: the Peregrine for BOTH gate runs - a shoe change between them would break comparability. HR: capped at AeT on climbs (hike to stay under); descents audited. AID ROUTINE: loop past the car/cache and rehearse a fixed <= 2-min stop (bottles, food, out) - no social dwell (ask #7). WATCH ALERT: set a high-HR alert at the hr_cap_bpm value (FR-y) - it is a number the watch enforces, not one you remember.

Pull them on any heel, knee or lateral-ankle signal. Never on ice or wet leaves. Everything else easy, capped at AeT. The 2/21 long effort (override) is the J-2 rehearsal of this mix past hour 7. G1 shoe gate 1/31 and the 2/7 long run use this day type - no new fuel variable on a footing test. sessions.key_cue: After a 15-min Z1-2 warm-up: 3 x 10 min of continuous climbing at +3..+7%, jog/walk down between. Remainder of the run Z1-2 on rolling terrain. RULE: HR at the alert (AeT) -> hike immediately until AeT-5, then run again. Hiking to stay aerobic is the session working, not failing. HILL SPRINTS x8: 8-10 s uphill at +8..+12% (max effort), full 2-3 min walk-down recovery - never cut the rest short. Progress by adding reps (max +2/week, cap 8), never by lengthening past 10 s; grade stays +8..+12% (posterior heel - deliberate deviation from UA's 30% hills). READ-OUT (FR tracking ask #4): lap-press every climb block; RS reports run_pct and mean HR on +5..+10% versus the Vermont baseline (debrief s3: ~60% run share on +5..+10% late). Target over the cycle: crossover up from ~7-8% at unchanged HR. WATCH ALERT: set a high-HR alert at the hr_cap_bpm value (FR-y) - it is a number the watch enforces, not one you remember.

Boat Basin (1.5 mi at +6.0%) if the Alpine woods are icy. Intensity: Aerobic quality (priority 1 - uphill running at low HR). SURFACE: gravel/dirt road or smooth trail at the named grade (terrain_intent grade; Terrain_Substitution_Rules_v1); a treadmill is allowed - log it, the descent field drops to the warm-up's. aet_gate.default_rationale: Aerobic-deficiency path (or untested): Z1-2 only. Strict gate (athlete decision 10/22): no work above AeT until a valid drift test gives AeT within 10% of LTHR.
aet_gate.pass_rule: Swap in if_pass once the latest valid drift test gives AeT >= 152 bpm (within 10% of LTHR 168). UA DOSE RULES (rev 2.3): Z3 starts at <= 5% of the week's run time (Cat 1 entry dose 20-30 min); the FIRST promoted week holds miles and vertical at the reference week (never raise distance, vertical and intensity together); no Z4 until Z3 has run at ~10% of weekly time, then 30/30s first. Promotion applies to Base/Build loading weeks only - Specificity (B2B peak) weeks, taper and race weeks carry no Z3 (UA: ultra S weeks cut Z3). Load fields are identical in both versions, so weekly sums do not change.

if_pass.title: Z3 uphill intervals - UA entry dose (AeT gate PASSED)
if_pass.key_cue: 3 x 8 min RUNNING uphill at +4..+7% held at 152-160 bpm (low Z3 - UA entry dose, <= 5% of the week); jog down as recovery. Warm up 15 min at Z1-2; everything outside the work blocks stays at or below AeT. HILL SPRINTS x8: 8-10 s uphill at +8..+12% (max effort), full 2-3 min walk-down recovery - never cut the rest short. Progress by adding reps (max +2/week, cap 8), never by lengthening past 10 s; grade stays +8..+12% (posterior heel - deliberate deviation from UA's 30% hills). Alactic - HR is irrelevant, so these are NOT gated by the AeT test (Uphill Athlete permits them in an aerobic-deficiency base). GATED ON: the single-leg hop test (strength plan W6) AND a quiet posterior heel. First thing pulled on any heel, Achilles or forefoot signal. READ-OUT (FR tracking ask #4): lap-press every climb block; RS reports run_pct and mean HR on +5..+10% versus the Vermont baseline (debrief s3: ~60% run share on +5..+10% late). Target over the cycle: crossover up from ~7-8% at unchanged HR. WATCH ALERT: set a high-HR alert at the block cap value (FR-y) - it is a number the watch enforces, not one you remember.

sessions.title: Easy TI swim
sessions.key_cue: DRILLS + CONTINUOUS EASY SWIMMING: ~10 min drills, then 200-400 m continuous at an easy, even SPL; bilateral breathing. EFFORT 3-4/10 throughout; if breathing gets ragged, go back to drills. HR is NOT capped: swim HR runs well below running HR at the same effort, so the running AeT cap does not apply - go by feel. SHOULDER RULE: stop at the first pinch at the front or top of the shoulder (left is the priority side); no paddles; hands enter wide ('railroad tracks'), never crossing the midline. KICK: relaxed 2-beat; ease it off if the calf or posterior heel tightens; no breaststroke kick (knees). Gentle wall push-offs.
sessions.notes: Cross-training (athlete, rev 2.2): general aerobic + upper-body work, light on the legs. NOT counted in run mileage, vertical or the ramp guard; counted in weekly hours. If the left shoulder reacts, swimming is dropped BEFORE Upper A (Upper A's cuff work is the protective part). Swim first, Upper B later (Upper B is push, so it complements the swim's pull).

sessions.title: GATE D #2 - December qualifying run
sessions.key_cue: GATE D QUALIFYING RUN (criteria agreed August; RS 27 Oct relaxed 'rolling' only - the descent criterion is unchanged): 20-22 mi RUNNABLE, with 3,000+ ft of DESCENT; the downs RUN, not hiked; then a clean 48-hour symptom window. POLE-FREE for comparability (ask #6). ROUTE (rev 2.6, RS ruling 27 Oct): BOAT BASIN x7 round trips (1.53 mi / ~477 ft each way at ~6%), ~21.4 mi / ~3,340 ft of descent - the card carries the route's honest ~3,340 ft (rev 2.7, RS F-1 option a); RS verifies the >= 3,000 ft threshold from the FIT, not the card. Same route, same rep order and same use of the flat section at the bottom between reps on BOTH days (as on 9/14). Park at the top in winter. Every descent RUN; if a rep's descent is hiked for any reason other than a short ice patch, record it in the body report - RS decides whether the day counts. Read against the 9/14 Peregrine baseline on the same road. This is a tissue-tolerance test, NOT a race simulation: do not inflate it (cover note). HR capped at AeT on climbs; descents audited. SHOES: the Peregrine for BOTH gate runs - a shoe change between them would break comparability. REPEAT: same route as #1 if at all possible, so the two are comparable. HR: capped at AeT on climbs (hike to stay under); descents audited. AID ROUTINE: loop past the car/cache and rehearse a fixed <= 2-min stop (bottles, food, out) - no social dwell (ask #7). WATCH ALERT: set a high-HR alert at the hr_cap_bpm value (FR-y) - it is a number the watch enforces, not one you remember.

Min 6 days between long runs. Intensity: GATE. FIT + 48-h symptom notes (heel, lateral ankle, knees, forefoot: morning ratings 0-10 on days +1 and +2) to Race Strategy; RS rules within a few days. PASS twice within three weeks -> the 103K is on. FAIL -> fallback is the 53K at the same event or a spring 50-miler, and this plan re-scopes by revision. VENUE (rev 2.6): Boat Basin x7, the same route as Gate D #1 (comparability).

daily_targets.notes: FUELING LADDER (FR-w: the problem is calorie MIX, not volume). BASE W3-13: proven gels every 25-30 min + water, 200-250 cal/hr; from W7 add ONE real-food item at ~hour 2 on runs >= 2.5 h, rotating (salted boiled potato, rice ball, 1/4 PB&J, banana, bread + cheese). BUILD W14-22: 250-280 cal/hr as a MIX - gels ~50%, half-strength GU Roctane Energy Drink Mix ~25%, real food ~25% every 45-60 min - so no single source runs over ~150 cal/hr (Vermont's fullness came at ~365 cal/hr, mostly gel + drink). The 2/21 long effort (override) is the J-2 rehearsal of this mix past hour 7. G1 shoe gate 1/31 and the 2/7 long run use this day type - no new fuel variable on a footing test. PEAK W23-26: race protocol v1 (overrides 3/7, 3/21). One new variable per run; hour 1 always on the proven baseline.

sessions.title: Aerobic climbing - run the climbs at or below AeT
sessions.key_cue: After a 15-min Z1-2 warm-up: 3 x 15 min of continuous climbing at +3..+7%, jog/walk down between. Remainder of the run Z1-2 on rolling terrain. RULE: HR at the alert (AeT) -> hike immediately until AeT-5, then run again. Hiking to stay aerobic is the session working, not failing. HILL SPRINTS x8: 8-10 s uphill at +8..+12% (max effort), full 2-3 min walk-down recovery - never cut the rest short. Progress by adding reps (max +2/week, cap 8), never by lengthening past 10 s; grade stays +8..+12% (posterior heel - deliberate deviation from UA's 30% hills). Alactic - HR is irrelevant, so these are NOT gated by the AeT test (Uphill Athlete permits them in an aerobic-deficiency base). GATED ON: the single-leg hop test (strength plan W6) AND a quiet posterior heel. First thing pulled on any heel, Achilles or forefoot signal. READ-OUT (FR tracking ask #4): lap-press every climb block; RS reports run_pct and mean HR on +5..+10% versus the Vermont baseline (debrief s3: ~60% run share on +5..+10% late). Target over the cycle: crossover up from ~7-8% at unchanged HR. WATCH ALERT: set a high-HR alert at the hr_cap_bpm value (FR-y) - it is a number the watch enforces, not one you remember.

sessions.title: Aerobic climbing - run the climbs at or below AeT
sessions.key_cue: After a 15-min Z1-2 warm-up: 4 x 12 min of continuous climbing at +3..+7%, jog/walk down between. Remainder of the run Z1-2 on rolling terrain. RULE: HR at the alert (AeT) -> hike immediately until AeT-5, then run again. Hiking to stay aerobic is the session working, not failing. HILL SPRINTS x8: 8-10 s uphill at +8..+12% (max effort), full 2-3 min walk-down recovery - never cut the rest short. Progress by adding reps (max +2/week, cap 8), never by lengthening past 10 s; grade stays +8..+12% (posterior heel - deliberate deviation from UA's 30% hills). Alactic - HR is irrelevant, so these are NOT gated by the AeT test (Uphill Athlete permits them in an aerobic-deficiency base). GATED ON: the single-leg hop test (strength plan W6) AND a quiet posterior heel. First thing pulled on any heel, Achilles or forefoot signal. READ-OUT (FR tracking ask #4): lap-press every climb block; RS reports run_pct and mean HR on +5..+10% versus the Vermont baseline (debrief s3: ~60% run share on +5..+10% late). Target over the cycle: crossover up from ~7-8% at unchanged HR. WATCH ALERT: set a high-HR alert at the hr_cap_bpm value (FR-y) - it is a number the watch enforces, not one you remember.

sessions.notes: VENUE (rev 2.4): Alpine loop COUNTERCLOCKWISE - its 1.12-mi +6.2% climb holds the blocks; the way back is mostly gentle (-4.6% average) but ends with 0.5 mi at ~-8.6% (0.25 mi at ~-11%) - run it relaxed, short strides; it is inside the card's descent. Boat Basin (1.5 mi at +6.0%) if the Alpine woods are icy. Intensity: Aerobic quality (priority 1 - uphill running at low HR). SURFACE: gravel/dirt road or smooth trail at the named grade (terrain_intent grade; Terrain_Substitution_Rules_v1); a treadmill is allowed - log it, the descent field drops to the warm-up's. SPRINT HILL (rev 2.4): the athlete's short steep local hills are fine; grade stays +8..+12% (posterior heel).

aet_gate.default_rationale: Aerobic-deficiency path (or untested): Z1-2 only. Strict gate (athlete decision 10/22): no work above AeT until a valid drift test gives AeT within 10% of LTHR.
aet_gate.pass_rule: Swap in if_pass once the latest valid drift test gives AeT >= 152 bpm (within 10% of LTHR 168). UA DOSE RULES (rev 2.3): Z3 starts at <= 5% of the week's run time (Cat 1 entry dose 20-30 min); the FIRST promoted week holds miles and vertical at the reference week (never raise distance, vertical and intensity together); no Z4 until Z3 has run at ~10% of weekly time, then 30/30s first. Promotion applies to Base/Build loading weeks only - Specificity (B2B peak) weeks, taper and race weeks carry no Z3 (UA: ultra S weeks cut Z3). Load fields are identical in both versions, so weekly sums do not change.

if_pass.title: Z3 uphill intervals - UA entry dose (AeT gate PASSED)
if_pass.key_cue: 3 x 10 min RUNNING uphill at +4..+7% held at 152-160 bpm (low Z3 - UA entry dose, <= 5% of the week); jog down as recovery. Warm up 15 min at Z1-2; everything outside the work blocks stays at or below AeT. HILL SPRINTS x8: 8-10 s uphill at +8..+12% (max effort), full 2-3 min walk-down recovery - never cut the rest short. Progress by adding reps (max +2/week, cap 8), never by lengthening past 10 s; grade stays +8..+12% (posterior heel - deliberate deviation from UA's 30% hills). Alactic - HR is irrelevant, so these are NOT gated by the AeT test (Uphill Athlete permits them in an aerobic-deficiency base). GATED ON: the single-leg hop test (strength plan W6) AND a quiet posterior heel. First thing pulled on any heel, Achilles or forefoot signal. READ-OUT (FR tracking ask #4): lap-press every climb block; RS reports run_pct and mean HR on +5..+10% versus the Vermont baseline (debrief s3: ~60% run share on +5..+10% late). Target over the cycle: crossover up from ~7-8% at unchanged HR. WATCH ALERT: set a high-HR alert at the block cap value (FR-y) - it is a number the watch enforces, not one you remember.

sessions.title: Easy TI swim
sessions.key_cue: DRILLS + CONTINUOUS EASY SWIMMING: ~10 min drills, then 200-400 m continuous at an easy, even SPL; bilateral breathing. EFFORT 3-4/10 throughout; if breathing gets ragged, go back to drills. HR is NOT capped: swim HR runs well below running HR at the same effort, so the running AeT cap does not apply - go by feel. SHOULDER RULE: stop at the first pinch at the front or top of the shoulder (left is the priority side); no paddles; hands enter wide ('railroad tracks'), never crossing the midline. KICK: relaxed 2-beat; ease it off if the calf or posterior heel tightens; no breaststroke kick (knees). Gentle wall push-offs.
sessions.notes: Cross-training (athlete, rev 2.2): general aerobic + upper-body work, light on the legs. NOT counted in run mileage, vertical or the ramp guard; counted in weekly hours. If the left shoulder reacts, swimming is dropped BEFORE Upper A (Upper A's cuff work is the protective part). Swim first, Upper B later (Upper B is push, so it complements the swim's pull).

sessions.key_cue: Uphill Athlete protocol. SETUP: treadmill at 3% (same machine and grade every test), CHEST STRAP (wet the contacts), fan on, COOL room (test #1 was run warm), same time of day and same pre-test meal as test #1, no caffeine in the 3 h before, after a rest day. WARM-UP 15 min: walk, then build speed until HR sits stable for 2-3 min at the STARTING HR. STARTING HR: 147 bpm (rev 2.2 - test #1 on 10/13 settled at 152 and drifted 5.2%, so AeT < 152; 152 - 5 = 147). STABILIZATION RULE: the test starts at the first lap press after HR has held within +/-2 bpm of the starting HR for 3 full minutes; if HR is still rising, drop the belt 0.1-0.2 mph and wait again; if not stable by 15:00, extend the warm-up rather than shorten the test. Retests after this start at the last measured AeT. LAP. TEST 60 min at ONE locked speed and grade - do not touch the controls. LAP at 30:00 and at 60:00. COOL-DOWN 10 min easy. RESULT = avg HR 2nd half / avg HR 1st half - 1. <3.5% = your AeT is higher: retest +5 bpm. 3.5-5.0% = AeT = your starting HR. >5% = started above AeT: retest -5 bpm. GATE: AeT >= 152 (within 10% of LTHR 168) -> no aerobic deficiency; Z3 sessions switch on. Below 152 -> Z1-2 only, retest in 4-6 weeks. FIT to the Drive inbox the same day.
sessions.notes: Intensity: Test. The hr_cap_bpm here is only the provisional alert; the starting HR in the cue governs. The test's 3% incline is NOT counted in elevation_gain_ft (a test, not training load). The result re-anchors EVERY AeT-referenced cap in this plan by patch revision (hr_anchor field). Retest #3 (moved from 1/5 into this recovery week, rev 2.3) - sets zones for the Feb-Mar block and is the LAST pre-race test (strict gate; no 2/16 test). A post-race test sets the next cycle's baseline.

sessions.title: Fast-feet run - pick-ups, downhill pick-ups, sprints
sessions.key_cue: FAST-FEET DAY. 10-15 min easy warm-up, then: HILL SPRINTS x4: 8-10 s uphill at +8..+12% (max effort - recovery-week half dose), full 2-3 min walk-down recovery - never cut the rest short. Progress by adding reps (max +2/week, cap 8), never by lengthening past 10 s; grade stays +8..+12% (posterior heel - deliberate deviation from UA's 30% hills). Alactic - HR is irrelevant, so these are NOT gated by the AeT test (Uphill Athlete permits them in an aerobic-deficiency base). GATED ON: the single-leg hop test (strength plan W6) AND a quiet posterior heel. First thing pulled on any heel, Achilles or forefoot signal. Then 3 x 1 min FAST DOWNHILL PICK-UPS (Uphill Athlete downhill-skill reps): on a SMOOTH -3..-6% road or dirt descent, fast and relaxed - quick feet, cadence 180+, never all-out, never braking; easy jog/walk back up (>= 2 min) between. Pull them on any heel, knee or lateral-ankle signal. Never on ice or wet leaves. Everything else easy, capped at AeT. WATCH ALERT: set a high-HR alert at the hr_cap_bpm value (FR-y) - it is a number the watch enforces, not one you remember.

sessions.title: Easy TI swim
sessions.key_cue: DRILLS + CONTINUOUS EASY SWIMMING: ~10 min drills, then 200-400 m continuous at an easy, even SPL; bilateral breathing. EFFORT 3-4/10 throughout; if breathing gets ragged, go back to drills. HR is NOT capped: swim HR runs well below running HR at the same effort, so the running AeT cap does not apply - go by feel. SHOULDER RULE: stop at the first pinch at the front or top of the shoulder (left is the priority side); no paddles; hands enter wide ('railroad tracks'), never crossing the midline. KICK: relaxed 2-beat; ease it off if the calf or posterior heel tightens; no breaststroke kick (knees). Gentle wall push-offs.

daily_targets.notes: FUELING LADDER (FR-w: the problem is calorie MIX, not volume). BASE W3-13: proven gels every 25-30 min + water, 200-250 cal/hr; from W7 add ONE real-food item at ~hour 2 on runs >= 2.5 h, rotating (salted boiled potato, rice ball, 1/4 PB&J, banana, bread + cheese). The 2/21 long effort (override) is the J-2 rehearsal of this mix past hour 7. G1 shoe gate 1/31 and the 2/7 long run use this day type - no new fuel variable on a footing test. PEAK W23-26: race protocol v1 (overrides 3/7, 3/21). One new variable per run; hour 1 always on the proven baseline.

sessions.title: Aerobic climbing - treadmill block at or below AeT
sessions.key_cue: TREADMILL (default Jan-Mar: steady grade, no ice, ascent without descent): 15 min Z1-2 at 1%, then ONE 45-min continuous climb at +6% (up to +7% only if the heel is quiet), then 10 min easy at 1%. RULE: HR at the alert (AeT) -> hike immediately until AeT-5, then run again. Hiking to stay aerobic is the session working, not failing. HEEL: never above +8% sustained; heel rating > 2/10 -> drop to +4% and tell the coach.  OUTDOOR ALTERNATIVE: the longest local road climb repeated - then log the descent (elevation_loss_ft rises; the Sunday check recomputes the week). READ-OUT (FR tracking ask #4): lap-press every climb block; RS reports run_pct and mean HR on +5..+10% versus the Vermont baseline (debrief s3: ~60% run share on +5..+10% late). sessions.key_cue: VENUE (rev 2.5.1): Alpine loop x6 (rocky woods trail - athlete 10/27; ~19.9 mi / ~2,400 ft, >= 4 h) - laps from the car. Six laps, not 6.5: the full 21.5 mi at Alpine would be ~2,600 ft, ~300 ft over the card; x6 is ~1.6 mi short and ~100 ft over, and still delivers the 4 h G1 needs. SHOE GATE G1 (RS FR-aa): >= 4 h on ROLLING ROCKY TRAIL in the CANDIDATE shoe - stability and toe protection on rocks (the job Oracle's singletrack was doing). Quick light feet, eyes 3-4 m ahead; WALK any steep technical descent (the descent ban still holds - this is footing, not descent dose). Ice or snow on the rocks -> move G1 to Sunday 2/7 and run this as a dirt-road long run (moving G1 takes the 2/14 long-effort backup off the table - RS F-3). RACE WEIGHT: carry the Tuscany mandatory kit - 1 L water minimum, waterproof jacket, thermal blanket, whistle, phone, headlamp + spare, cup (cover-note ask #2). POLES (Black Diamond Carbon Z): deploy on sustained climbs >= +8% and on steep descents <= -10%; stowed in the quiver elsewhere. HR: capped at AeT on climbs (hike to stay under); descents audited. AID ROUTINE: loop past the car/cache and rehearse a fixed <= 2-min stop (bottles, food, out) - no social dwell (ask #7). sessions.title: Easy TI swim - active recovery
sessions.key_cue: DRILLS + CONTINUOUS EASY SWIMMING: ~10 min drills, then 200-400 m continuous at an easy, even SPL; bilateral breathing. EFFORT 3-4/10 throughout; if breathing gets ragged, go back to drills. HR is NOT capped: swim HR runs well below running HR at the same effort, so the running AeT cap does not apply - go by feel. sessions.title: Aerobic climbing - treadmill block at or below AeT
sessions.key_cue: TREADMILL (default Jan-Mar: steady grade, no ice, ascent without descent): 15 min Z1-2 at 1%, then ONE 55-min continuous climb at +6% (up to +7% only if the heel is quiet), then 10 min easy at 1%. RULE: HR at the alert (AeT) -> hike immediately until AeT-5, then run again. Hiking to stay aerobic is the session working, not failing. HEEL: never above +8% sustained; heel rating > 2/10 -> drop to +4% and tell the coach.  OUTDOOR ALTERNATIVE: the longest local road climb repeated - then log the descent (elevation_loss_ft rises; the Sunday check recomputes the week). READ-OUT (FR tracking ask #4): lap-press every climb block; RS reports run_pct and mean HR on +5..+10% versus the Vermont baseline (debrief s3: ~60% run share on +5..+10% late). Target over the cycle: crossover up from ~7-8% at unchanged HR. WATCH ALERT: set a high-HR alert at the hr_cap_bpm value (FR-y) - it is a number the watch enforces, not one you remember.
sessions.fueling_notes: 1 gel at 45 min if over 75 min.
sessions.notes: Intensity: Aerobic quality (priority 1 - uphill running at low HR). VERTICAL (rev 2.3): treadmill incline COUNTS in elevation_gain_ft (ascent load is real and sits inside the ramp guard); elevation_loss_ft = 0, which keeps this week's descent budget for Thursday and Sunday.

sessions.key_cue: 3 x 1.5 mi sustained at -5..-8%. Plus 2 short steep pitches (-10..-15%) with POLES on a short steep local hill. Climb back up by easy run or hike - the ascent is transport. Median RUNNING cadence 175+ on every rep; lap-press each rep. HR on descents is audited, not governed. sessions.notes: Intensity: Aerobic + eccentric dose (priority 2 / J-4). SURFACE: Boat Basin road (-6.1%, most stable grade in the archive; 1.5 mi continuous, so no rep is longer than 1.5 mi) or a graded fire road; non-technical always. Perkins Memorial Drive is not used (rev 2.4: winter closure, crowding). WINTER PARKING AT THE TOP (RS check 10/22): warm up on the flat at the top, run the first descent as rep 1, end the session at the top - rep count and descent miles unchanged. 24-H SYMPTOM READ (heel, lateral ankle, knees) gates next week's progression. READ-OUT: running-only cadence and step length, first rep vs last rep at matched grade (C-5 basis). WINTER: never on ice - move the day, or garage-ramp repeats / treadmill decline as partial credit. VERTICAL FIX (rev 2.3): distance and elevation now count the full descent of every rep (~317 ft per descent-mile at -6%) and the climb back up - earlier cards understated both.

sessions.title: Fast-feet run - pick-ups, downhill pick-ups, sprints
sessions.key_cue: FAST-FEET DAY. 10-15 min easy warm-up, then: HILL SPRINTS x8: 8-10 s uphill at +8..+12% (max effort), full 2-3 min walk-down recovery - never cut the rest short. Progress by adding reps (max +2/week, cap 8), never by lengthening past 10 s; grade stays +8..+12% (posterior heel - deliberate deviation from UA's 30% hills). Alactic - HR is irrelevant, so these are NOT gated by the AeT test (Uphill Athlete permits them in an aerobic-deficiency base). GATED ON: the single-leg hop test (strength plan W6) AND a quiet posterior heel. First thing pulled on any heel, Achilles or forefoot signal. Then 5 x 1.5 min FAST DOWNHILL PICK-UPS (Uphill Athlete downhill-skill reps): on a SMOOTH -3..-6% road or dirt descent, fast and relaxed - quick feet, cadence 180+, never all-out, never braking; easy jog/walk back up (>= 2 min) between. Pull them on any heel, knee or lateral-ankle signal. Never on ice or wet leaves. Everything else easy, capped at AeT. WATCH ALERT: set a high-HR alert at the hr_cap_bpm value (FR-y) - it is a number the watch enforces, not one you remember.
sessions.notes: Intensity: Aerobic + neuromuscular (short, fully recovered reps). Friday is two days before the long run - this is the week's one speed/skill session (UA: pick-ups, fast downhill pick-ups and hill sprints), never the day before a long run. SPRINT HILL (rev 2.4): the athlete's short steep local hills are fine; grade stays +8..+12% (posterior heel).

sessions.title: Easy TI swim - active recovery
sessions.key_cue: DRILLS + CONTINUOUS EASY SWIMMING: ~10 min drills, then 200-400 m continuous at an easy, even SPL; bilateral breathing. RULE: HR at the alert (AeT) -> hike immediately until AeT-5, then run again. Hiking to stay aerobic is the session working, not failing. HEEL: never above +8% sustained; heel rating > 2/10 -> drop to +4% and tell the coach. Shorter block - pre-effort week. OUTDOOR ALTERNATIVE: the longest local road climb repeated - then log the descent (elevation_loss_ft rises; the Sunday check recomputes the week). READ-OUT (FR tracking ask #4): lap-press every climb block; RS reports run_pct and mean HR on +5..+10% versus the Vermont baseline (debrief s3: ~60% run share on +5..+10% late). Target over the cycle: crossover up from ~7-8% at unchanged HR. WATCH ALERT: set a high-HR alert at the hr_cap_bpm value (FR-y) - it is a number the watch enforces, not one you remember.

WINTER PARKING AT THE TOP (RS check 10/22): warm up on the flat at the top, run the first descent as rep 1, end the session at the top - rep count and descent miles unchanged. 24-H SYMPTOM READ (heel, lateral ankle, knees) gates next week's progression. sessions.key_cue: FAST-FEET DAY. 10-15 min easy warm-up, then: HILL SPRINTS x6: 8-10 s uphill at +8..+12% (max effort, -30% volume), full 2-3 min walk-down recovery - never cut the rest short. Progress by adding reps (max +2/week, cap 8), never by lengthening past 10 s; grade stays +8..+12% (posterior heel - deliberate deviation from UA's 30% hills). Alactic - HR is irrelevant, so these are NOT gated by the AeT test (Uphill Athlete permits them in an aerobic-deficiency base). GATED ON: the single-leg hop test (strength plan W6) AND a quiet posterior heel. First thing pulled on any heel, Achilles or forefoot signal. Then 4 x 1 min FAST DOWNHILL PICK-UPS (Uphill Athlete downhill-skill reps): on a SMOOTH -3..-6% road or dirt descent, fast and relaxed - quick feet, cadence 180+, never all-out, never braking; easy jog/walk back up (>= 2 min) between. Pull them on any heel, knee or lateral-ankle signal. Never on ice or wet leaves. Everything else easy, capped at AeT. WATCH ALERT: set a high-HR alert at the hr_cap_bpm value (FR-y) - it is a number the watch enforces, not one you remember.

daily_targets.notes: FUELING LADDER (FR-w: the problem is calorie MIX, not volume). BASE W3-13: proven gels every 25-30 min + water, 200-250 cal/hr; from W7 add ONE real-food item at ~hour 2 on runs >= 2.5 h, rotating (salted boiled potato, rice ball, 1/4 PB&J, banana, bread + cheese). sessions.title: Easy TI swim - active recovery
sessions.key_cue: DRILLS + CONTINUOUS EASY SWIMMING: ~10 min drills, then 200-400 m continuous at an easy, even SPL; bilateral breathing. EFFORT 3-4/10 throughout; if breathing gets ragged, go back to drills. HR is NOT capped: swim HR runs well below running HR at the same effort, so the running AeT cap does not apply - go by feel. sessions.title: Aerobic climbing - treadmill block at or below AeT
sessions.key_cue: TREADMILL (default Jan-Mar: steady grade, no ice, ascent without descent): 15 min Z1-2 at 1%, then ONE 30-min continuous climb at +6% (up to +7% only if the heel is quiet), then 10 min easy at 1%. RULE: HR at the alert (AeT) -> hike immediately until AeT-5, then run again. Hiking to stay aerobic is the session working, not failing. HEEL: never above +8% sustained; heel rating > 2/10 -> drop to +4% and tell the coach. Short block - effort week. OUTDOOR ALTERNATIVE: the longest local road climb repeated - then log the descent (elevation_loss_ft rises; the Sunday check recomputes the week). READ-OUT (FR tracking ask #4): lap-press every climb block; RS reports run_pct and mean HR on +5..+10% versus the Vermont baseline (debrief s3: ~60% run share on +5..+10% late). Target over the cycle: crossover up from ~7-8% at unchanged HR. WATCH ALERT: set a high-HR alert at the hr_cap_bpm value (FR-y) - it is a number the watch enforces, not one you remember.
sessions.fueling_notes: 1 gel at 45 min if over 75 min.
sessions.notes: Intensity: Aerobic quality (priority 1 - uphill running at low HR). VERTICAL (rev 2.3): treadmill incline COUNTS in elevation_gain_ft (ascent load is real and sits inside the ramp guard); elevation_loss_ft = 0, which keeps this week's descent budget for Thursday and Sunday.

ONE CONTINUOUS SUPPORTED DAY: 35-40 mi or 8-10 h, whichever comes first, on HARD FIRE ROAD - VENUE (rev 2.6, RS ruling 27 Oct): FEBAPPLE loop x3.8 (~38 mi / ~3,800 ft), as loops from the car. SURFACE OVER VERTICAL for this day: 3,800 ft is the figure of record - do not make up the ~800 ft elsewhere (no second venue, no added Alpine laps). The same venue applies on any backup date - the car is the aid station every ~2-2.5 h. 05:00 START (sunrise ~06:45): the first ~1.75 h by headlamp, including a descent - this is also the Tuscany race-start simulation (race breakfast ~03:00, nutrition override). HR: Z1-2, capped at AeT ALL DAY - pacing discipline when tired is one of the jobs (S-3); no late by-feel allowance in a training run. JOBS: J-1 hours 7-10 (first exposure past 33 mi / 6:40); J-2 REAL FOOD from hour 3 + the drink-mix replacement, every item logged (time, item, ~cal, ~sodium, GI notes); J-3 headlamp start; S-1 POLES: start without, collect them at the car at ~mi 25-28 and use them for the rest (the Gallina switch); S-2 SHOE GATE G2: the candidate shoe on 30+ mi of hard dirt road (cushioning over hours of hard-surface impact); S-4 AID: every car stop TIMED, <= 2 min, set list (bottles, food, out). REPORT TO RS: FIT, fueling log, body report at the finish and at ~24/48 h (heel/Achilles, knees, ankles, feet), pole and shoe notes. WEATHER: never on icy descents. ONLY backup = Sunday 2/14 (RS F-1: 2/28 would put the 3/7 rough-descent block 7 days after an 8-10 h day) - decide on the forecast by Wednesday 2/10; If G1 ran on Sun 2/7 (backup), the 2/14 long-effort backup is OFF (RS F-3: no 4 h+ run inside the pre-effort week) - only the Sat 2/20 short-notice fallback remains.  if 2/14 is used, W20 becomes the effort week and W21 the recovery week (TP patch). If 2/21 itself turns bad at short notice: Saturday 2/20 (swap with the shakeout). LAST-RESORT WEEKDAY FALLBACK (RS, athlete-confirmed): if G1 ran on 2/7 AND the weather rules out both Sat 2/20 and Sun 2/21, the effort runs on a weekday Wed 2/17 - Thu 2/25, chosen on a 2-3 day forecast (>= 10 days after G1, >= 10 days before rough-descent block #1 on 3/7); TP reshuffles the surrounding days (taper-class days before, recovery days after) by patch. Protocol, deliverables and the 3/7, 3/21, 3/28 blocks unchanged. sessions.title: Easy TI swim
sessions.key_cue: DRILLS + CONTINUOUS EASY SWIMMING: ~10 min drills, then 200-400 m continuous at an easy, even SPL; bilateral breathing. EFFORT 3-4/10 throughout; if breathing gets ragged, go back to drills. HR is NOT capped: swim HR runs well below running HR at the same effort, so the running AeT cap does not apply - go by feel. SHOULDER RULE: stop at the first pinch at the front or top of the shoulder (left is the priority side); no paddles; hands enter wide ('railroad tracks'), never crossing the midline. KICK: relaxed 2-beat; ease it off if the calf or posterior heel tightens; no breaststroke kick (knees). Gentle wall push-offs.

sessions.title: Fast-feet run - pick-ups, downhill pick-ups, sprints
sessions.key_cue: FAST-FEET DAY. 10-15 min easy warm-up, then: HILL SPRINTS x8: 8-10 s uphill at +8..+12% (max effort), full 2-3 min walk-down recovery - never cut the rest short. Progress by adding reps (max +2/week, cap 8), never by lengthening past 10 s; grade stays +8..+12% (posterior heel - deliberate deviation from UA's 30% hills). Alactic - HR is irrelevant, so these are NOT gated by the AeT test (Uphill Athlete permits them in an aerobic-deficiency base). GATED ON: the single-leg hop test (strength plan W6) AND a quiet posterior heel. First thing pulled on any heel, Achilles or forefoot signal. Then 5 x 1.5 min FAST DOWNHILL PICK-UPS (Uphill Athlete downhill-skill reps): on a SMOOTH -3..-6% road or dirt descent, fast and relaxed - quick feet, cadence 180+, never all-out, never braking; easy jog/walk back up (>= 2 min) between. Pull them on any heel, knee or lateral-ankle signal. Never on ice or wet leaves. Everything else easy, capped at AeT. WATCH ALERT: set a high-HR alert at the hr_cap_bpm value (FR-y) - it is a number the watch enforces, not one you remember.

sessions.title: Long run - OVERLOOK partial (late steep-descent block #1)
sessions.key_cue: OVERLOOK (rev 2.4; RS check 10/22) - card totals held. ROUTE: ~21.5 mi of rolling road/dirt FIRST, in loops from the Overlook trailhead car (aid routine), holding ~80-90 ft/mi (~1,730 ft). Plot and check this loop well before 3/7; if no such loop exists, run the FALLBACK. Never split the day across two venues - the block must land on legs tired from this same run. LATE STEEP-DESCENT BLOCK (last hour): climb Overlook ~1.5 mi to ~2,780 ft (hike, at or below AeT) and descend it: ~1,020 ft at ~-13% (quarter-miles to ~-16%). POLES on <= -10%, cadence 175+, short strides, quiet feet; walking the steepest quarters is permitted. OVERLOAD dose relative to Tuscany's -10% legs, not a grade match. TOE PROTECTION: report whether the road was rough enough to test it (3/14 and 3/28 also read it). GATED: only if Gate D PASSED and the heel/ankle/knee gates are clean this week. ICE RULE: go/no-go by Thu 3/4 from a road-condition check - any snow or ice on the road above ~2,500 ft = FALLBACK. FALLBACK (rev 2.5): Alpine loop x7 (~23 mi / ~2,800 ft); late rough-descent block 1.5 mi at -8..-15% in the last hour = the 0.5-mi ~-8.6% pitch at the end of each of the LAST 3 laps, poles; never sustained technical singletrack; smooth non-technical descent if the gates are not clean. Race fueling protocol v1 (nutrition override 3/7). No wet-feet test today (moved to 3/14). FIT flagged for RS (read as an overload steep_down sample). RACE WEIGHT: carry the Tuscany mandatory kit - 1 L water minimum, waterproof jacket, thermal blanket, whistle, phone, headlamp + spare, cup (cover-note ask #2). POLES (Black Diamond Carbon Z): deploy on sustained climbs >= +8% and on steep descents <= -10%; stowed in the quiver elsewhere. HR: capped at AeT on climbs (hike to stay under); descents audited. AID ROUTINE: loop past the car/cache and rehearse a fixed <= 2-min stop (bottles, food, out) - no social dwell (ask #7). WATCH ALERT: set a high-HR alert at the hr_cap_bpm value (FR-y) - it is a number the watch enforces, not one you remember.

sessions.title: Easy TI swim - active recovery
sessions.key_cue: PEAK RUN WEEK - TECHNIQUE ONLY: drills + a few easy lengths. Nothing that feels like training. EFFORT 3-4/10 throughout; if breathing gets ragged, go back to drills. HR is NOT capped: swim HR runs well below running HR at the same effort, so the running AeT cap does not apply - go by feel. SHOULDER RULE: stop at the first pinch at the front or top of the shoulder (left is the priority side); no paddles; hands enter wide ('railroad tracks'), never crossing the midline. KICK: relaxed 2-beat; ease it off if the calf or posterior heel tightens; no breaststroke kick (knees). Gentle wall push-offs.
sessions.notes: Cross-training (athlete, rev 2.2): general aerobic + upper-body work, light on the legs. NOT counted in run mileage, vertical or the ramp guard; counted in weekly hours. sessions.title: Aerobic climbing - treadmill block at or below AeT
sessions.key_cue: TREADMILL (default Jan-Mar: steady grade, no ice, ascent without descent): 15 min Z1-2 at 1%, then ONE 65-min continuous climb at +6% (up to +7% only if the heel is quiet), then 10 min easy at 1%. RULE: HR at the alert (AeT) -> hike immediately until AeT-5, then run again. Hiking to stay aerobic is the session working, not failing. HEEL: never above +8% sustained; heel rating > 2/10 -> drop to +4% and tell the coach. MOUNTAIN-CLIMB REHEARSAL: Tuscany's defining climb is 5.6 mi / +2,086 ft at ~7% from hour ~8 - this is the local analog.  OUTDOOR ALTERNATIVE: the longest local road climb repeated - then log the descent (elevation_loss_ft rises; the Sunday check recomputes the week). READ-OUT (FR tracking ask #4): lap-press every climb block; RS reports run_pct and mean HR on +5..+10% versus the Vermont baseline (debrief s3: ~60% run share on +5..+10% late). Target over the cycle: crossover up from ~7-8% at unchanged HR. WATCH ALERT: set a high-HR alert at the hr_cap_bpm value (FR-y) - it is a number the watch enforces, not one you remember.

WINTER PARKING AT THE TOP (RS check 10/22): warm up on the flat at the top, run the first descent as rep 1, end the session at the top - rep count and descent miles unchanged. 24-H SYMPTOM READ (heel, lateral ankle, knees) gates next week's progression. sessions.key_cue: FAST-FEET DAY. 10-15 min easy warm-up, then: HILL SPRINTS x8: 8-10 s uphill at +8..+12% (max effort), full 2-3 min walk-down recovery - never cut the rest short. Progress by adding reps (max +2/week, cap 8), never by lengthening past 10 s; grade stays +8..+12% (posterior heel - deliberate deviation from UA's 30% hills). Alactic - HR is irrelevant, so these are NOT gated by the AeT test (Uphill Athlete permits them in an aerobic-deficiency base). GATED ON: the single-leg hop test (strength plan W6) AND a quiet posterior heel. First thing pulled on any heel, Achilles or forefoot signal. Then 5 x 1.5 min FAST DOWNHILL PICK-UPS (Uphill Athlete downhill-skill reps): on a SMOOTH -3..-6% road or dirt descent, fast and relaxed - quick feet, cadence 180+, never all-out, never braking; easy jog/walk back up (>= 2 min) between. Pull them on any heel, knee or lateral-ankle signal. Never on ice or wet leaves. Everything else easy, capped at AeT. WATCH ALERT: set a high-HR alert at the hr_cap_bpm value (FR-y) - it is a number the watch enforces, not one you remember.

sessions.key_cue: VENUE (rev 2.5): Febapple loop x2.5 (~25 mi / ~2,500 ft; ~300 ft under the card - fine). SURFACE (RS memo 3c; venue rev 2.5): Febapple loop (South Mountain hard fire road, 10.0 mi, ~1,000 ft/loop). Tuscany's front 2/3 is hard gravel farm road; this is the most specific volume surface available. WET-FEET TEST (RS memo 3d; moved here in rev 2.4): take an ankle-deep creek crossing in the first hour (walk it - Tuscany rule), then run on in wet socks - the sock/lube/shoe system is the test. Skip if the water is icy. RACE WEIGHT: carry the Tuscany mandatory kit - 1 L water minimum, waterproof jacket, thermal blanket, whistle, phone, headlamp + spare, cup (cover-note ask #2). POLES (Black Diamond Carbon Z): deploy on sustained climbs >= +8% and on steep descents <= -10%; stowed in the quiver elsewhere. HR: capped at AeT on climbs (hike to stay under); descents audited. AID ROUTINE: loop past the car/cache and rehearse a fixed <= 2-min stop (bottles, food, out) - no social dwell (ask #7). WATCH ALERT: set a high-HR alert at the hr_cap_bpm value (FR-y) - it is a number the watch enforces, not one you remember.

sessions.title: Aerobic climbing - treadmill block at or below AeT
sessions.key_cue: TREADMILL (default Jan-Mar: steady grade, no ice, ascent without descent): 15 min Z1-2 at 1%, then ONE 70-min continuous climb at +6% (up to +7% only if the heel is quiet), then 10 min easy at 1%. RULE: HR at the alert (AeT) -> hike immediately until AeT-5, then run again. Hiking to stay aerobic is the session working, not failing. HEEL: never above +8% sustained; heel rating > 2/10 -> drop to +4% and tell the coach. MOUNTAIN-CLIMB REHEARSAL: Tuscany's defining climb is 5.6 mi / +2,086 ft at ~7% from hour ~8 - this is the local analog.  OUTDOOR ALTERNATIVE: the longest local road climb repeated - then log the descent (elevation_loss_ft rises; the Sunday check recomputes the week). READ-OUT (FR tracking ask #4): lap-press every climb block; RS reports run_pct and mean HR on +5..+10% versus the Vermont baseline (debrief s3: ~60% run share on +5..+10% late). Target over the cycle: crossover up from ~7-8% at unchanged HR. WATCH ALERT: set a high-HR alert at the hr_cap_bpm value (FR-y) - it is a number the watch enforces, not one you remember.

sessions.key_cue: 1.5 + 1.5 + 1.0 + 1.0 mi sustained at -5..-8% (rev 2.4 split, descent-miles held). Repeat of last week - last rep the best-form rep. Climb back up by easy run or hike - the ascent is transport. Median RUNNING cadence 175+ on every rep; lap-press each rep. HR on descents is audited, not governed. WATCH ALERT: set a high-HR alert at the hr_cap_bpm value (FR-y) - it is a number the watch enforces, not one you remember.
sessions.notes: Intensity: Aerobic + eccentric dose (priority 2 / J-4). SURFACE: Boat Basin road (-6.1%, most stable grade in the archive; 1.5 mi continuous, so no rep is longer than 1.5 mi) or a graded fire road; non-technical always. Perkins Memorial Drive is not used (rev 2.4: winter closure, crowding). sessions.key_cue: Last 3-h+ run. Easy, poles, race kit. VENUE (rev 2.5): Alpine loop - COUNTERCLOCKWISE x6 (~19.9 mi / ~2,400 ft). Creek on the loop for the wet-feet test. POLES (Black Diamond Carbon Z): deploy on sustained climbs >= +8% and on steep descents <= -10%; stowed in the quiver elsewhere. HR: capped at AeT on climbs (hike to stay under); descents audited. sessions.title: Fast-feet run - pick-ups, downhill pick-ups, sprints
sessions.key_cue: FAST-FEET DAY. 10-15 min easy warm-up, then: HILL SPRINTS x4: 8-10 s uphill at +8..+12% (max effort, -30% volume), full 2-3 min walk-down recovery - never cut the rest short. Progress by adding reps (max +2/week, cap 8), never by lengthening past 10 s; grade stays +8..+12% (posterior heel - deliberate deviation from UA's 30% hills). Alactic - HR is irrelevant, so these are NOT gated by the AeT test (Uphill Athlete permits them in an aerobic-deficiency base). GATED ON: the single-leg hop test (strength plan W6) AND a quiet posterior heel. First thing pulled on any heel, Achilles or forefoot signal. Then 4 x 45 s FAST DOWNHILL PICK-UPS (Uphill Athlete downhill-skill reps): on a SMOOTH -3..-6% road or dirt descent, fast and relaxed - quick feet, cadence 180+, never all-out, never braking; easy jog/walk back up (>= 2 min) between. Pull them on any heel, knee or lateral-ankle signal. Never on ice or wet leaves. Everything else easy, capped at AeT. WATCH ALERT: set a high-HR alert at the hr_cap_bpm value (FR-y) - it is a number the watch enforces, not one you remember.
sessions.notes: Intensity: Aerobic + neuromuscular, recovery-week dose (UA R week: hill sprints halved, late in the week; one run with fast downhill pick-ups). SPRINT HILL (rev 2.4): the athlete's short steep local hills are fine; grade stays +8..+12% (posterior heel).

sessions.title: Fast-feet run - pick-ups, downhill pick-ups, sprints
sessions.key_cue: FAST-FEET DAY. 10-15 min easy warm-up, then: HILL SPRINTS x3: 8-10 s uphill at +8..+12% (max effort, -30% volume), full 2-3 min walk-down recovery - never cut the rest short. Progress by adding reps (max +2/week, cap 8), never by lengthening past 10 s; grade stays +8..+12% (posterior heel - deliberate deviation from UA's 30% hills). Alactic - HR is irrelevant, so these are NOT gated by the AeT test (Uphill Athlete permits them in an aerobic-deficiency base). GATED ON: the single-leg hop test (strength plan W6) AND a quiet posterior heel. First thing pulled on any heel, Achilles or forefoot signal. Then 3 x 30 s FAST DOWNHILL PICK-UPS (Uphill Athlete downhill-skill reps): on a SMOOTH -3..-6% road or dirt descent, fast and relaxed - quick feet, cadence 180+, never all-out, never braking; easy jog/walk back up (>= 2 min) between. Pull them on any heel, knee or lateral-ankle signal. Never on ice or wet leaves. Everything else easy, capped at AeT. WATCH ALERT: set a high-HR alert at the hr_cap_bpm value (FR-y) - it is a number the watch enforces, not one you remember.

sessions.title: Easy TI swim
sessions.key_cue: DRILLS + CONTINUOUS EASY SWIMMING: ~10 min drills, then 200-400 m continuous at an easy, even SPL; bilateral breathing. EFFORT 3-4/10 throughout; if breathing gets ragged, go back to drills. HR is NOT capped: swim HR runs well below running HR at the same effort, so the running AeT cap does not apply - go by feel. SHOULDER RULE: stop at the first pinch at the front or top of the shoulder (left is the priority side); no paddles; hands enter wide ('railroad tracks'), never crossing the midline. KICK: relaxed 2-beat; ease it off if the calf or posterior heel tightens; no breaststroke kick (knees). Gentle wall push-offs.
